name: Ccx Corporation
old_description: CCX is proud to be a best in class, North American manufacturer of custom and high speed cables and connectivity solutions. We produce custom cables according to customer specifications as well as high speed fiber, copper and power cables and a complete suite of optics. We do all of this with a friendly and educated team.
about:
CCX Corporation operates from Broomfield, Colorado, drawing on over three decades of cable design and manufacturing experience. The company positions itself as a North American manufacturer of custom and high-speed cables and connectivity solutions, producing custom cables to customer specifications alongside high-speed fiber, copper, power cables, and a full suite of optics. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed, and ownership structure is not specified.

The company's capabilities span simple and complex wire harnesses with dozens to hundreds of components, coaxial cable assemblies for 50- and 75-ohm applications including low-loss variants, ribbon assemblies in flat, folded, and color-coded configurations, and custom injection over-molding for strain relief and interconnects. CCX also terminates motor and fan leads, manufactures power cords and adapters certified to UL, cUL, ENEC, VDE, CE, and CCC standards, and builds fiber patch cables (1–144 fibers, OS2/OM1–OM5) in a Class 10k clean room. Copper offerings cover CAT5e through CAT8 in shielded and unshielded versions, plus SAS 3.0 12 Gbps assemblies. The product line extends to compatible optics (SFPs), direct-attach and active optical cables with stateside stocking, and data-center rack integration services.

CCX serves original equipment manufacturers, resellers, and data-center operators. Its customer base includes companies such as Arrow, referenced in a testimonial, and the firm highlights rack-and-stack integration projects for data-center clients. The company markets directly to both OEMs and channel partners through its website.

CCX emphasizes quality-first manufacturing, on-time delivery, and what it describes as unparalleled customer service backed by a friendly, educated team. Differentiators cited include a Class 10k clean room for fiber production, lifetime warranty on optics, TAA-compliant options across power, fiber, and copper lines, and domestic stocking for quick-turn DAC and AOC orders.
